issues.on_page: Operating revenues: Charges for services: ... Other revenues 21,740
issues.issue: [fixed: charges for services/fees] On p6, 'Other revenues' is printed under the 'Charges for services:' heading, and p2 counts it in business-type Charges for Services 1,018,305 (= 972,331 + 24,234 + 21,740). Under the 2026-11-06 ruling, a generic utility other revenue that the report counts in Charges for Services is charges for services, not other (Bloomfield FY2022 was treated that way).

issues.on_page: Budget schedule p7: Property taxes-county 259,475 + Motor vehicle taxes-county 21,850 = 281,325
issues.issue: The report prints a breakdown that adds up exactly and shows 21,850 of the 'Property taxes' line is motor vehicle tax. The extractor kept it as printed property tax (a printed tax-type label), as in FY2023. Whether to split it is the user's call.

This is a cost-type line (utility bills: power, gas, phone) with category 'utilities', the same name as the function category. Under the utility cost-type rule a cost-type name such as 'Utilities (Power, Gas, Phone)' may be intended. The same applies to detail[66], detail[76] and detail[87].

issues.on_page: Cash 828,605 + Cash with County Treasurer 15,007 + Restricted cash 153,465 (no printed cash total)
issues.issue: ending_cash is a sum the extractor computed, and beginning_cash is null. The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is filled only where printed and never derived. The arithmetic is correct.
